tool.name: TestCompression
tool.summary: Benchmarks multiple compression settings to find optimal configurations with detailed Excel reports.

usage.bullet_item: Automatically tests dozens of compression combinations based on product type presets or custom CSV configurations.
Generates comprehensive Excel reports with compression efficiency, file sizes, read/write speeds, and performance ratios.
Supports all major compression algorithms: JPEG, JXL, LZW, DEFLATE, ZSTD, LERC, and uncompressed baseline.
Perfect for performance benchmarking, algorithm selection, and optimization parameter tuning.

param.name: source_geotiff
param.displayname: Source GeoTIFF, Raster Layer, or Folder
param.datatype: Raster Layer; Raster Dataset; File; Folder

P.SPAN: The source GeoTIFF file or raster layer that will be used as input for all compression tests. This file will be processed through multiple compression algorithms and parameter combinations to evaluate their performance and efficiency.

The path and filename for the comprehensive Excel report (.xlsx) that will contain detailed results for all compression tests. The report includes metrics such as file sizes, compression percentages, read/write speeds, and performance comparisons.

Choose how to specify the compression tests to run. 'Use Product Type Presets' automatically selects optimized compression tests based on the product type (DEM, Image, etc.) using pre-configured CSV files. 'Use Custom CSV File' allows you to specify a custom CSV file containing your own compression parameter combinations for testing.

The type of GeoTIFF product, used to select appropriate compression test presets. These presets are configured in separate CSV files in gttk/resources/templates/ and test various combinations optimized for each product type.

A custom CSV file containing compression parameter combinations to test. The CSV must include mandatory columns: 'type' (dem, image, error, scientific, thematic) and 'algorithm' (JPEG, JXL, LZW, DEFLATE, ZSTD, LERC, NONE). Optional columns include: 'level', 'predictor', 'quality', 'decimals', 'max_z_error', 'vertical_srs', 'nodata', 'cog', 'overviews', and 'tile_size'. Each row represents one compression test.

The directory where temporary files will be stored during testing. Each compression test generates a temporary COG/GeoTIFF that is measured for performance metrics. If not specified, a default './temp' directory will be created in the project root.

Controls whether temporary compressed GeoTIFF files created during testing should be automatically deleted after processing. When checked (default), temporary files are deleted immediately after measuring performance metrics to save disk space. Uncheck to preserve files for manual inspection and detailed analysis.

If checked, the generated Excel report will be automatically opened in your default spreadsheet application when testing completes. The Excel report contains comprehensive data including file sizes, compression percentages, read/write speeds, performance ratios, and detailed comments about each test.
